Code

Responsibilities: 
Life Safety Systems Engineer

We're looking for a Fire Protection / Life Safety Systems (LSS) Engineer who is excited about working on projects
that enable the heart of our client’s business. The ideal candidate will be located in AZ, OR, TX or PA, however,
qualified candidates located elsewhere in the U.S will also be considered.

As a LSS Engineer working with our teams, you’ll use your skills and experience to help our clients, by providing code-
compliant asset protection and fire life safety mitigation solutions. You will be expected to both provide guidance to co-workers and receive solutions from variance senior design professionals so that you can take ownership of various projects as the engineer of record. These fire solutions entail fire sprinklers, gaseous agents, fire detection, toxic gas detection, smoke modeling, and explosion prevention.

You will interface directly with client counterparts in the designing of their facilities and state and local code officials. Utilizing AutoCAD and Revit MEP, our teams create 3D models in coordination with architects and engineers. From those 3D BIM models you’ll design fire sprinkler systems, fire alarm systems, smoke and leak detection, security and intrusion detection systems, and more. Using the various applicable Life Safety & Fire codes as well as industry standards you will provide calculations; equipment size and quantities; equipment and construction specifications; network diagrams and various construction deliverables in both 2D and 3D platforms for a constructible design.

Job Location: Auburn Hills, MI        
Shift: 1st Shift
Benefits: 401K, Dental insurance, Life Insurance, Medical Insurance, Vision Insurance 
Compensation: $30.75/HR
 
Responsibilities
This role involves making and testing lab batches for the adhesive product line. Preparation, testing, and evaluation are performed against internal standards and/or automotive customer specifications. Data is documented in an electronic lab notebook and may be issued as a formal report. Organization of data and test work is essential. The candidate must be able to work with changing priorities and adhere to timelines. This is a full-time, on-site position.

Key Roles and Responsibilities
  • Co-develop new products according to customer needs, specifications, and business strategy.
  • Make adhesive batches, conduct lab tests on paste and cured adhesives, organize and prepare substrates, collect and document data.
  • Work in teams to scale up products according to established procedures and process capabilities.
  • Collaborate with colleagues to learn best lab practices, build competency, and work independently, safely, and efficiently.
  • Ensure product quality and performance meet customer requirements by staying current on customer performance standards.
  • Follow and promote environmental, health, and safety practices.
  • Evaluate new materials or components as needed.
  • Maintain lab equipment as the ERP (Equipment Responsible Person).
  • Conduct experiments with high quality, analyze data, and interpret results.
Essential Functions
  • Prepare intermediates and adhesive batches.
  • Lift and move pails weighing up to 50 lbs.
  • Weigh raw materials and charge them into mixers.
  • Scrape mixer bowls, remove adhesives, and clean mixers.
  • Transfer and package samples into containers and condition environments.
  • Characterize and test adhesives, including liquid property testing (viscosity, rheology, sag panels).
  • Apply adhesives to substrates using manual or automatic caulking guns.
  • Perform various mechanical property tests.
Lab Preparation and Documentation
  • Manage inventory, order, organize, and distribute materials regularly.
  • Keep lab benches clean, dispose of materials properly, and replenish supplies from storage.
  • Calibrate or verify equipment daily and record results.
  • Use the Electronic Lab Notebook to document plans, work, and data daily.
  • Conduct and document health and safety audits.
Qualifications
  • High school diploma or GED required, associate or bachelor’s degree in a STEM field preferred.
  • No PhD or master’s degree candidates.
  • Previous laboratory experience in an industrial or R&D environment required.
  • Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and a commitment to safe and efficient work practices.
  • Self-motivated, able to work in a fast-paced environment, eager to learn new skills, and able to effectively prioritize and plan responsibilities.
  • Good teamwork and interpersonal skills; enjoys working with a diverse team.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Excel, Word, PowerPoint, OneDrive, Outlook, and Microsoft Teams.
  • Comfortable entering and analyzing data in Excel or similar software, with the ability to recognize abnormal data.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Able to regularly lift and/or move up to 10 lbs, and frequently up to 40 lbs.
  • Knowledge or experience with polymers is preferred but not required.

title: Anesthesiologist Services
description:
10 hours per week
Tuesdays and Thursday

Overview:

The Anesthesiologist provides comprehensive anesthesia care to patients undergoing medical, dental, or psychiatric procedures within a state-operated psychiatric center. This role involves ensuring the safe administration of anesthesia and sedation, evaluating patients' medical conditions prior to procedures, and collaborating with a multidisciplinary team to support the overall health and safety of individuals with complex psychiatric and medical needs.

Description of Services:

The Anesthesiologist will be responsible for performing professional medical work in the field of anesthesiology, including but not limited to:

  • Pre-Procedure Assessment:

    • Conduct pre-anesthetic evaluations to determine patients' physical status, psychiatric history, and any factors that may influence anesthesia management.

    • Review medical charts, laboratory results, and consult with psychiatrists, physicians, and nurses to establish safe anesthesia plans.

  • Administration of Anesthesia:

    • Administer general, regional, or local anesthesia, and sedation for a variety of procedures including electroconvulsive therapy (ECT), dental procedures, or emergency medical interventions.

    • Monitor patients continuously during anesthesia to ensure stability of vital signs and responsiveness to treatment.

  • Post-Anesthesia Care:

    • Provide post-anesthesia monitoring and management until patients safely recover from sedation or anesthesia.

    • Address any complications or adverse reactions promptly and document all findings in the medical record.

  • Collaboration & Consultation:

    • Work closely with psychiatrists, nurses, and other clinical staff to ensure safe and coordinated patient care.

    • Provide guidance regarding anesthesia risk management and contribute to patient treatment planning when necessary.

  • Compliance and Documentation:

    • Maintain accurate, timely, and complete anesthesia records in accordance with facility policies and state and federal regulations.

    • Follow all safety protocols and standards of practice established by the American Society of Anesthesiologists (ASA) and relevant governing bodies.

Qualifications:

  • Doctor of Medicine (MD) or Doctor of Osteopathy (DO) degree.

  • Completion of an accredited anesthesiology residency program.

  • Current license to practice medicine in the State of New York (or applicable state).

  • Board Certification or Board Eligibility in Anesthesiology.

  • Current certification in Basic and Advanced Cardiac Life Support (BLS, ACLS).

  • Experience in hospital or psychiatric settings preferred, particularly with ECT or procedures involving behavioral health populations.

Schedule and Work Setting:

  • Services may be required on a part-time, per diem, or scheduled basis, depending on facility needs.

  • Most anesthesia services will be provided in the medical suite, ECT suite, or designated treatment areas within the psychiatric center.

  • The role may require collaboration with other departments to support patients with co-occurring medical and psychiatric conditions.

title: Product Manager – II (Retail Execution)
description:
I am a recruiting consultant with Artech, and I am hoping I can help you find the perfect next opportunity for your career goals. You very well could be happy in your present role but might be looking for a more challenging project or maybe you want to explore opportunities outside your comfort zone.  I am currently recruiting for a Product Manager – II (Retail Execution) for one of our direct clients in the US.  Below are the specs for the role:
 
Job Title: Product Manager – II (Retail Execution)
Work Location: Remote (MUST work in EST Hours)
Duration of Assignment: 6+ Months - Potential for Conversion
Pay Rate Range: $40.00 - $48.00/hr on W2
Job Description:
Overview
The Digital team is transforming the way Client’s customers, suppliers, sales, and service organizations interact with each other through its digital experiences. As the Product Manager for Retail Execution, you’ll lead initiatives that reimagine the tools and experiences our field sales consultants and merchandisers need to execute flawlessly in stores — from shelf sets and display builds to compliance tracking and real-time issue resolution. This role requires a self-starter who can work independently, engage cross-functional teams, and deliver measurable impact in speed, visibility, and sales execution quality.
You’ll develop task-driven tools to efficiently set up new displays in store, ensure shelves are fully stocked, and activity is validated through image-based capture. You’ll partner with Supply Chain to ensure merchandising activity is planned and routed efficiently based on delivery schedules. You’ll create value for the company and our customers by helping us execute merchandising in more customer locations, thus helping consumers more easily shop and decide on the products they need to buy.
This role is critical in shaping our experience for our field team. You’ll work cross-functionally with design, engineering, data science, and key partners in commercial to imagine and build end to end experiences with the user at the center. You’ll need to seamlessly integrate your experience into a broader app strategy for in-field teams and enable field leadership the ability to see rollup activity and assign tasks to their team as needed.
Duties & Key Responsibilities
• Define a clear product vision that improves how field teams plan, execute, and report in-store activities.
• Translate strategic business goals — such as reducing non-selling time, improving compliance accuracy, and increasing sales per visit — into actionable product outcomes.
• Use data, feedback, and field insights to continuously refine priorities and identify high-impact opportunities.
• Shadow sales consultants and merchandisers to deeply understand pain points in shelf setup, display execution, and compliance reporting.
• Partner with field leaders and commercial teams to design tools that simplify work, reduce manual effort, and improve visibility.
• Leverage user research, ride-alongs, and analytics to ensure solutions are intuitive and drive measurable adoption.
• Own and maintain a clear, data-informed product roadmap for field enablement tools (mobile and web).
• Write detailed user stories and acceptance criteria that reflect real-world workflows and constraints.
• Prioritize features balancing customer impact, operational efficiency, and technical feasibility.
• Drive end-to-end delivery in partnership with engineering, design, and business process owners — from discovery to rollout and feedback loops.
• Act as the single point of accountability for product decisions — clearly communicating trade-offs, timelines, and expected outcomes.
• Provide transparent updates to leadership through concise roadmaps, progress summaries, and performance dashboards.
• Establish and track KPIs such as time to complete store visits, percentage of compliant displays, reduction in manual reporting, and increase in sales per route.
• Use quantitative and qualitative feedback to inform backlog prioritization and identify optimization opportunities.
• Promote a test-and-learn culture — piloting new features with field teams before scaling.
Ideal Candidate Profile
• Experience building products for field sales, retail execution, or merchandising enablement.
• Strong empathy for end users who work in fast-paced, offline, or mobile-first environments
• Proven ability to balance long-term product strategy with short-term delivery execution.
• Comfortable working in a contract-to-hire setting with high autonomy and accountability for results.

description:
Title: Certified Medical Assistant
Temp to Perm: Temp w/ possible perm
Length of Assignment: 3 months
Work Location: Plano, TX - 75093
Work Schedule: Mon-Fri 8a-5:45p
Interview Type: TEAMS - 1 or 2 rounds
Certification/Degree Requirements: CMA, BLS
Top Skills: GI, Oncology or Family medicine exp highly preferred, epic exp preferred, 2 years of CMA experience, Bilingual highly preferred

JOB SUMMARY:
The Certified Medical Assistant 2, under the direction of a physician, assists in the delivery of health care for patients. This position performs a wide variety of patient care activities including, but not limited to, maintenance of clinical record/documentation, administering medications, giving injections and taking vital signs. This position may assists in scheduling, mentoring and training staff.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS of the ROLE:
Assists in examination and treatment of patients under the direction of a physician. Prepares treatment rooms for examination of patients. Cleans rooms after procedures, cleans and disinfects equipment, restocks supplies. Assists with inventory levels to ensure availability of necessary supplies, equipment and instruments, and records as necessary. Assists and accompanies patients from waiting room and prepares patients for examination. Interviews patients and records or inputs information to patients' medical record. Collects all medical data in order to facilitate the physician's ability to draw conclusions about the patient's needs. Ensure all charts and forms for the office visit are ready for the provider. Measures, collects and records patient's vital signs (i.e., pulse rate*** temperature, blood pressure, weight, and height), and prepares patients for examinations and tests, procedures and x-rays. Performs routine patient testing, acquires and processes electrocardiograms, and collects and processes blood specimens and urine samples. Prepares and administers routine oral, rectal, medications, injections and vaccinations excluding controlled substances, as directed by Physician. Identifies and reports adverse reactions. Removes sutures and staples and change sterile and non-sterile dressings, as requested. Performs administrative related duties such as answering telephones, taking and relaying messages and scheduling patient appointments. Facilitates or leads huddles and various team meetings. May manage process workflow and/or staff schedules, and assists in mentoring and training staff. Identifies issues and participates in process improvement initiatives.

KEY SUCCESS FACTORS:
Medical assistant certification from a program accredited by American Association of Medical Assistants or the American Medical Technologists. Knowledge of principles of safe and accurate medical administration. Knowledge of the 5 rights: right patient, right medication, right dose, right route, right time. Ability to accurately document patient information in accordance with organizational policies, regulations and procedures. Familiarity with HIPPA regulations. Ability to make observations of the general physical condition of the patient and notifies the nurse/healthcare provider of abnormalities. Ability to give injections and draw blood. Knowledge of medical terminology. Excellent bedside manner and ability to make patients feel at ease. Appears friendly, reassuring and approachable to patients. Ability to take instruction from a doctor. Familiarity with medical charts and records. High attention to detail.

title: Quality Technician IV
description:
Description:
Quality Technician Overview

The Quality Technician is capable of conducting, auditing, inspecting, and testing of the Quality System Programs. Each technician must appropreiatly monitor and respond to all process operating guidelines.

Quality Lab Schedule:
2nd Shift QC Technician 03:15pm-11:15pm

QC Technician Daily Responsibilities
1. Key point of contact to help identify and resolve issues for any and all food safety, regulatory and quality issues on the shift (holds, sanitation concerns, start ups, extraneous investigations, etc)

2. Product attributes for the previous shift must be reviewed at the beginning of each shift (including net contents). Operations will print all holdable attributes from KPOG for the shift folder which is turned into QA at the end of their shift.


3. Each technician is to review mixing sheets (207’s) during the shift. When auditing the mixing sheets, errors such as incorrect lot numbers, quantities, temperatures, etc should be identified.


4. Metal Detection
a. Review Metal Detector checks completed during the shift and react to any non-conformities, sign off at the end of the shift.
b. If any metal detector failure/deviation occurs a risk assessment must be completed by the end of your shift on the day of the occurrence.
c. Create and maintain test packages.

5. Holds
a. Technician will lead the initial investigation and get the right resources involved in the investigation to complete the 5 why and corrective action sections.
b. Holds must be documented in the database and must clearly identify the non-conformities. Supporting data should be documented in the hold details. Supporting data includes, but is not limited to, the following: Investigation details, root cause/corrective action, KPOGs data points, specification limits .
c. Categorize (I, II, or III) holds appropriately
d. Take pictures of any issues that will support the hold for non-conforming product.
e. Perform traces in Red Prairie and notify Supervsir/manager if suspect product has shipped.
f. Request product from the hi-rise, assess pallet timeframes to see which pallets fit the hold timeline for disposition or rework.
g. Set up rework form and pull samples for retesting. Work with operations to sample/rework Quality Holds.
h. Reconcile hold folder up to and including holds database, kwic report and hold form.
i.

6. Model 26 Documention is to be reviewed daily. Any deviations should be caputured in the Deviation report & Finished Goods hold notice to Quality management and operations (BUMS, Supervisor, etc).

7. Extraneous findings should be uploaded to the teamsite and stored in the file cabinet in the Main Quality office. They are not to be left on the counter.

i. Lead the extraneous investigations to determine the source. Assist operations in completing the Deviation Reports.

8. GMP/Food Safety Inspections
i. Pre-operational inspections must be completed prior to start-up whenever an area has been idle for 8 hours or more. Production lines should not start up unless the required paperwork ins turned into Quality and completed forms are stored in the appropritate binder located in the Quality office
ii. Equipment must be inspected after maintenance work is completed. An orange tag will need to be signed off for these events.
iii. Ad hoc inspections are required for other events that are Quality or Food Safety concerns: environmental issues, bloodborne pathogens, brittle plastic or broken glass


9. Each QC technician is expected to troubleshoot and resolve issues for equipment occurring on their shift.

10. Shift Reports must be completed and saved to the team site on a daily basis to keep track of all quality issues that occur on each shift.



QC Technician Individual Responsibilities

• Lab equipment (weekly) calibrations ??
• RFT/Faulty –
• GMP Inspections
• Incoming ingredient review & release
• Raw and packaging material complaints/investigations
• Consumer complaint investigstions
• Provide Quality training sessions at Leadership meetings and aassist with all required Compliance trainings for hourly employees.

description:

Duration: 12 Months Contract
Location: Longmont CO

We are looking for a Lab Technician to support SSD hardware bring-up, testing, and lab operations. Responsibilities include troubleshooting hardware and software issues, resolving SSD setup failures, executing test plans, managing lab inventory, and coordinating the shipping and receiving of hardware. You’ll work closely with development, test, facilities, and other departments to facilitate lab activities, bring up new hardware per project schedules, and actively contribute to lab planning—including space, budget, and resource needs.   • Participate in SCRUM meetings and provide regular updates on assigned tasks and progress.
  • Identify and implement efficiency improvements through automation of recurring lab tasks.
  • Represent the lab team in cross-functional meetings and lead task force initiatives from a lab operations perspective.

Technical Requirements:
  • Hands-on experience troubleshooting and repairing NVMe/PCIe SSD hardware and software setups.
  • Proven ability to build test systems, execute test plans, and summarize results.
  • Comfortable performing repetitive manual test procedures with high attention to detail.
  • Strong communication skills and ability to work independently using written instructions.
  • Familiarity with Unix command-line environments; scripting in Shell or Python is a plus.
  • Proficient in Excel for data tracking and reporting.
  • Experience assembling, modifying, and reassembling SSD test systems.
  • Prior exposure to SSD lab environments is a strong advantage.
  • Experience automating lab activities and driving efficiency improvements is a plus.
  • Motivated to lead task forces and adopt new technologies quickly.
  • Continuous learning mindset and adaptability to evolving technical environments.

title: Quality Technician IV
description:
Description:
Quality Technician Overview

The Quality Technician is capable of conducting, auditing, inspecting, and testing of the Quality System Programs. Each technician must appropreiatly monitor and respond to all process operating guidelines.

Quality Lab Schedule
1st Shift QC Technician 07:15am-03:15pm
2nd Shift QC Technician 03:15pm-11:15pm
3rd Shift QC Technician 11:15pm-07:15am


QC Technician Daily Responsibilities

1. Key point of contact to help identify and resolve issues for any and all food safety, regulatory and quality issues on the shift (holds, sanitation concerns, start ups, extraneous investigations, etc)

2. Product attributes for the previous shift must be reviewed at the beginning of each shift (including net contents). Operations will print all holdable attributes from KPOG for the shift folder which is turned into QA at the end of their shift.


3. Each technician is to review mixing sheets (207’s) during the shift. When auditing the mixing sheets, errors such as incorrect lot numbers, quantities, temperatures, etc should be identified.


4. Metal Detection
a. Review Metal Detector checks completed during the shift and react to any non-conformities, sign off at the end of the shift.
b. If any metal detector failure/deviation occurs a risk assessment must be completed by the end of your shift on the day of the occurrence.
c. Create and maintain test packages.

5. Holds
a. Technician will lead the initial investigation and get the right resources involved in the investigation to complete the 5 why and corrective action sections.
b. Holds must be documented in the database and must clearly identify the non-conformities. Supporting data should be documented in the hold details. Supporting data includes, but is not limited to, the following: Investigation details, root cause/corrective action, KPOGs data points, specification limits .
c. Categorize (I, II, or III) holds appropriately
d. Take pictures of any issues that will support the hold for non-conforming product.
e. Perform traces in Red Prairie and notify Supervsir/manager if suspect product has shipped.
f. Request product from the hi-rise, assess pallet timeframes to see which pallets fit the hold timeline for disposition or rework.
g. Set up rework form and pull samples for retesting. Work with operations to sample/rework Quality Holds.
h. Reconcile hold folder up to and including holds database, kwic report and hold form.
i.

6. Model 26 Documention is to be reviewed daily. Any deviations should be caputured in the Deviation report & Finished Goods hold notice to Quality management and operations (BUMS, Supervisor, etc).

7. Extraneous findings should be uploaded to the teamsite and stored in the file cabinet in the Main Quality office. They are not to be left on the counter.

i. Lead the extraneous investigations to determine the source. Assist operations in completing the Deviation Reports.

8. GMP/Food Safety Inspections
i. Pre-operational inspections must be completed prior to start-up whenever an area has been idle for 8 hours or more. Production lines should not start up unless the required paperwork ins turned into Quality and completed forms are stored in the appropritate binder located in the Quality office
ii. Equipment must be inspected after maintenance work is completed. An orange tag will need to be signed off for these events.
iii. Ad hoc inspections are required for other events that are Quality or Food Safety concerns: environmental issues, bloodborne pathogens, brittle plastic or broken glass


9. Each QC technician is expected to troubleshoot and resolve issues for equipment occurring on their shift.

10. Shift Reports must be completed and saved to the team site on a daily basis to keep track of all quality issues that occur on each shift.



QC Technician Individual Responsibilities

• Lab equipment (weekly) calibrations ??
• RFT/Faulty –
• GMP Inspections
• Incoming ingredient review & release
• Raw and packaging material complaints/investigations
• Consumer complaint investigstions
• Provide Quality training sessions at Leadership meetings and aassist with all required Compliance trainings for hourly employees.

description:
Job Description:
Job Title: Construction Inspector
Location: (Onsite), San Antonio, TX (78215)
Duration: 12-month contract
Job ID: # 25-66659
 
Position Summary:
The Construction Inspector will monitor, assess, evaluate, verify, discuss, decide, resolve, report and document contractor construction activities as to ensure that the client design requirements, associated drawings and specifications, along with all Local, State, and Federal regulations and industry best practices, are being met in a daily, effective, and in an environmentally safe manner. 

Tasks and Responsibilities: 
  • Serve as a field liaison between contractors, with various areas of client, and customers as needed.
  • Ensures contractors are working safely and to client Standards and Specifications, processes and procedures.
  • Ensure contractors are following the provided client designs and standards, coordinating approved modifications as appropriate
  • Attend and participate in preconstruction/planning, ongoing construction status, and post-construction meetings. 
  • Perform field investigations to follow up on work completed and respond to customer concerns. 
  • Identify, stop and report any contractor safety infractions to client management and/or contract crew management.
  • Meets with the contract foreman to assist in problem resolution. 
  • Coordinates contractor work with client entities and various 3rd party entities. 
  • Ensure contract work is performed in a safe and timely manner, meeting expected deadlines, and as economically efficient as possible. 
  • Communicates with designers and other stakeholders regarding all changes made in the field. 
  • Conducts inspections of Overhead Lines. 
  • Plans, coordinates and tracks work assigned to contractors. 
  • Performs other duties as assigned. 
Minimum Knowledge and Abilities:
  • Ability to effectively communicate (written and verbal) at all levels of the organization 
  • Aptitude and experience in reading and interpreting constructions designs. 
  • Ability to understand safety and company policies and standards
  • Dedicated and flexible with work time as needed to meet the business needs of work area
  • Ability to work Emergency Call Out
  • Knowledge of client construction standards and safety guidelines
  • Extensive experience in Overhead construction 
Preferred Qualifications:
  • Experience in Overhead construction
  • Experience as an Overhead journeyman or above
  • Vegetation experience in Arboriculture or Horticulture

title: Estimator
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION: PROJECT ENGINEER / ESTIMATOR
Project Engineer/Estimator will provide technical support to the Estimating Team and Project Management Team. The position will bridge the process of project estimation through project completion. The following list is a summary of responsibilities although additional work tasks may be required by the company’s operations or clients.

  • Project Engineer will report to the Executive Vice President of Preconstruction
  • Attend pre-bid meetings with customers, owners, engineers, and architects as required.
  • Meet weekly to review bid priorities. Ensure that all bids are prepared and submitted as directed by the Exec VP of Pre-Construction.
  • Perform accurate estimate take-offs to provide project quantities to the Estimating Team using Blue Beam
  • Attend formal and informal training sessions to understand the various Software Programs utilized in Estimating (Blue Beam, Heavy Bid) and Project Management (Sage, Microsoft Project)
  • As required, pick up plans for jobs to be estimated from customer locations. Review specifics of the job with the customer while at the project site
  • Obtain quotes from at least three sources of supply for equipment rentals and materials to be purchased.
  • As necessary, visit job sites of projects being bid to ensure that all job conditions are known and accounted for in the estimate.
  • Where appropriate, maintain and revise a checklist of general jobsite conditions that could potentially affect the company’s costs to perform a project.
  • When jobs are awarded to the company, prepare purchase orders with vendors for materials with releases to be scheduled by the project team.
  • After orders have been placed with vendors, make follow-up calls as appropriate to ensure the timely delivery/availability of the materials as per the schedule.
  • When bidding projects or phases significantly different from past jobs, obtain input from the Project Manager to ensure agreement that all requirements have been adequately identified and that sufficient hours have been estimated.
  • When bidding a job for a contractor, determine, where possible what other contractors are bidding the work and advise the estimating team.
  • Create estimate proposal letters for client submission
  • As jobs are awarded to the company, attend job kick-off meetings and provide information to the Project Manager and Job Foremen on the details of each project.
  • When jobs are awarded to the company, create an electronic “CONFORMED ESTIMATE” file that includes all quotes, drawings, subcontracts and all final documents upon which the project price was based.
  • Perform and update all NJ One Calls for the company.
  • As required by the scope of the additional work being requested by the customer, prepare estimates for change orders and submit them for approval.
  • On a regular basis search for new sources of supply for the company’s most commonly purchased items. Where possible, maintain at least two vendors for all commonly purchased items.
  • Advise subcontractors whose performance requires removal from the approved list. Propose potential new subcontractors.
  • Handle all warranty returns to the manufacturers of any defective equipment returned from the field.
  • Complete and maintain the HC Project Checklist for each new Job Award and ensure that all tasks are completed by the due dates as established by the Job Kick-off meeting.
  • Job Award
    • Primary Role:
      • Attend all Job Award Meetings
    • Support Project Manager with:
      • Review of Job Plans and Specs thoroughly within 2 days of Job Award- notify Project Manager of any discrepancies or inconsistencies
      • Determine HC Schedule Based on HC Estimate and Customer Requirements
  • Job Set Up
    • Obtain all current plans and specifications from Estimating folder and move to Construction file
    • Print set for Project Manager and Foreman
    • Work with Estimating to get all reports from HCSS to Construction file
      • Cost Report
      • Resource Report
  • Plans and Specification
    • Familiarize with plans, specifications, and Scope of work Letter
  • Subcontractor and material Procurement
    • Review project plans and Resource Report for all subcontractor and vendor requirements for the project
    • Subcontractors:
      • Obtain three quotes for subcontract work. Work with Estimating to see if three quotes was already secured.
      • Prepare leveling sheet for final selection of subcontractors
  • Work with Project Manager and Purchasing to complete subcontracting process with subcontract agreement. Subcontract agreement issuance to be by Purchasing
  • Vendors
    • Perform take off verification of material quantities from plans and estimate
    • Obtain three quotes for major vendor materials. Work with Estimating to see if three quotes was already secured.
    • Prepare leveling sheet for final selection of vendors.
    • Work with Project Manager and Purchasing to complete buy out process. Purchase order issuance to be by Purchasing
  • Submittals
    • Develop submittal checklist from plans and specifications
    • Assist in obtaining and reviewing information and approvals for processing of shop drawings, product data and samples. Assist in the communication of this information across all levels of the project team.
    • Work with Project Manager and Dee to have them submitted to client
  • Scheduling
    • Work with Project Managers to get schedules into Microsoft Projects and to help facilitate Two Week Look Aheads
  • Request for Information
    • Assist Project Managers in the submission and responses for Requests for Information (RFI’s).
  • Change Orders
    • Assisting Project Manager and Estimators with take offs and pricing for change order of ongoing projects.
  • As-Builts
    • Assist in the preparation of final records for the project including close-out documents, Operations/Maintenance (OM) Manuals, etc.

title: Quality Technician - Non Exempt
description:
Quality Technician Overview

The Quality Technician is capable of conducting, auditing, inspecting, and testing of the Quality System Programs. Each technician must appropriately monitor and respond to all process operating guidelines.

QC Technician Daily Responsibilities

1. Key point of contact to help identify and resolve issues for any and all food safety, regulatory and quality issues on the shift (holds, sanitation concerns, start ups, extraneous investigations, etc)

2. Product attributes for the previous shift must be reviewed at the beginning of each shift (including net contents). Operations will print all holdable attributes from KPOG for the shift folder which is turned into QA at the end of their shift.


3. Each technician is to review mixing sheets (207’s) during the shift. When auditing the mixing sheets, errors such as incorrect lot numbers, quantities, temperatures, etc should be identified.


4. Metal Detection
a. Review Metal Detector checks completed during the shift and react to any non-conformities, sign off at the end of the shift.
b. If any metal detector failure/deviation occurs a risk assessment must be completed by the end of your shift on the day of the occurrence.
c. Create and maintain test packages.

5. Holds
a. Technician will lead the initial investigation and get the right resources involved in the investigation to complete the 5 why and corrective action sections.
b. Holds must be documented in the database and must clearly identify the non-conformities. Supporting data should be documented in the hold details. Supporting data includes, but is not limited to, the following: Investigation details, root cause/corrective action, KPOGs data points, specification limits .
c. Categorize (I, II, or III) holds appropriately
d. Take pictures of any issues that will support the hold for non-conforming product.
e. Perform traces in Red Prairie and notify Supervisor/manager if suspect product has shipped.
f. Request product from the hi-rise, assess pallet timeframes to see which pallets fit the hold timeline for disposition or rework.
g. Set up rework form and pull samples for retesting. Work with operations to sample/rework Quality Holds.
h. Reconcile hold folder up to and including holds database, kwic report and hold form.
i.

6. Model 26 Documentation is to be reviewed daily. Any deviations should be captured in the Deviation report & Finished Goods hold notice to Quality management and operations (BUMS, Supervisor, etc).

7. Extraneous findings should be uploaded to the team-site and stored in the file cabinet in the Main Quality office. They are not to be left on the counter.

i. Lead the extraneous investigations to determine the source. Assist operations in completing the Deviation Reports.

8. GMP/Food Safety Inspections
i. Pre-operational inspections must be completed prior to start-up whenever an area has been idle for 8 hours or more. Production lines should not start up unless the required paperwork ins turned into Quality and completed forms are stored in the appropriate binder located in the Quality office
ii. Equipment must be inspected after maintenance work is completed. An orange tag will need to be signed off for these events.
iii. Ad hoc inspections are required for other events that are Quality or Food Safety concerns: environmental issues, bloodborne pathogens, brittle plastic or broken glass


9. Each QC technician is expected to troubleshoot and resolve issues for equipment occurring on their shift.

10. Shift Reports must be completed and saved to the team site on a daily basis to keep track of all quality issues that occur on each shift.

QC Technician Individual Responsibilities

• Lab equipment (weekly) calibrations
• RFT/Faulty –
• GMP Inspections
• Incoming ingredient review & release
• Raw and packaging material complaints/investigations
• Consumer complaint investigations
• Provide Quality training sessions at Leadership meetings and assist with all required Compliance trainings for hourly employees.

Additional Information
Shift is 3pm - 11pm
Onsite
$28.00 - $30.00 based on experience

description:

title: Senior Trade Compliance Classification Analyst
description:
Role Summary: RV Tech is seeking an experienced and adaptable Interim Trade Compliance Specialist for a 6-month contract. This individual will serve as a critical stop-gap, immediately alleviating the urgent operational workload associated with international parts imports and ensuring continuity until our full-time Trade Compliance Manager is onboarded. This role requires a hands-on, proactive problem-solver comfortable working in an undefined space, building processes, and directly interfacing with our global partners.

Responsibilities (Key Contributions):

  • HTS Classification & Facilitation: Perform Harmonized Tariff Schedule (HTS) Code determination and facilitate classification requests with external providers for parts and prototypes.
  • Resolve Shipment Blockers: Proactively manage and resolve customs-related issues, including responding to inquiries regarding Government Agencies like FDA, NHTSA, and EPA-VNE.
  • Supplier & Broker Coordination: Serve as a point of contact for suppliers and customs brokers to obtain necessary documentation (e.g., HAWB, Arrival Notices) and ensure timely customs clearance.
  • Data Management: Maintain clear records and supporting documentation for all HTS classifications and import activities, aiding in future audits and ensuring data integrity.
  • Guidance & Support: Respond to basic classification and import inquiries from internal stakeholders and external partners, escalating complex legal or policy questions as needed.
  • Knowledge Transfer: Actively document processes and provide comprehensive knowledge transfer to the incoming full-time Trade Compliance Manager, ensuring a smooth transition.
Required Skills & Experience:
  • 5+ years of hands-on experience in import/export compliance, with at least 2 years directly assigning Harmonized Tariff (HTS) Codes.
  • Proven ability to independently manage and troubleshoot customs clearance issues for international shipments.
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, ambiguous startup environment; strong inclination identifying opportunities for improvement.
  • Demonstrated urgency and adaptability in resolving time-sensitive import issues (e.g., managing a high volume of urgent requests/emails).
  • Strong working knowledge of U.S. Customs regulations, import programs, and Partner Government Agencies (PGAs) requirements.
  • Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to effectively interface with engineering, procurement, logistics, and international brand partners.
  • Highly organized with strong attention to detail and a commitment to accuracy.
  • Self-starter mentality with critical thinking skills; ability to address issues and make independent decisions with limited supervision.
  • BA/BS degree in International Trade, Business, Supply Chain, or a related field.
Preferred Qualifications:
  • Experience with automotive or high-tech manufacturing imports.
  • U.S. Customs Broker License.
  • Knowledge and experience with Export Control Classification Numbers (ECCN).
  • Familiarity with global trade management tools (e.g., SAP, Coupa, Integration Point, Basecamp, Witz).

description:

  • Our Machine Operators fill a vital role in the manufacturing process, as they machine the components for our products and act as the first line of defense in the quality control process.

description:
Job Description:

  • Seeking a Dealer Advisor and Systems Analyst to join our ARO Parts & Service team.
  • This role is uniquely positioned at the intersection of business operations and information technology, supporting dealers who utilize our Retail Inventory Management (RIM) applications.
  • The successful candidate will combine strong communication and analytical skills with a solid technical foundation to ensure smooth operation of dealer parts replenishment and integration processes.

Responsibilities
  • Serve as a primary point of contact for dealership personnel regarding our Retail Inventory Management (RIM) applications.
  • Support dealers in understanding and optimizing automated parts replenishment processes based on sales demand and inventory parameters.
  • Monitor and troubleshoot daily data transmissions from dealership DMS (Dealer Management Systems) to corporate systems.
  • Review, interpret, and validate inbound and outbound data files, including sales, inventory, and order data.
  • Utilize SQL queries to investigate data issues and verify system accuracy.
  • Work within Unix environments to access, review, and troubleshoot dealer data files as needed.
  • Use MQ file transmission tools to ensure successful data flow between dealer systems and corporate servers.
  • Collaborate with IT, field personnel, and third-party DMS providers to resolve system or communication issues.
  • Identify trends or recurring issues and recommend process or system improvements.
  • Provide user education and guidance on system functionality and data best practices.

Requirements:
  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Information Technology, Computer Science, or related field - or equivalent experience.
  • 3+ years of experience in dealership operations, automotive parts management, or related corporate support role.
  • Proficiency in SQL for querying and troubleshooting data.
  • Experience navigating and reviewing files within a Unix environment.
  • Working knowledge of MQ or similar message/file transmission systems.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.
  • Ability to interpret and troubleshoot data files and transmission logs in a complex systems environment.
  • Proven ability to bridge business and technical teams effectively.
  • % of travel: Maybe 10%, Possibly once or twice a month to Dearborn, MI

Preferred:
  • Experience with dealership management systems (Reynolds & Reynolds, CDK, Dealertrack, etc.).
  • Familiarity with automotive parts replenishment or inventory control systems (RIM, D2DLink, etc.).
  • Background in IT systems support, data integration, or business systems analysis.
  • Understanding of EDI, flat file processing, or API data exchange.

Additional Information / Must Have's:
  • Strong fundamentals with databases, SQL, data mining, and basic programming background
  • Ability to communicate clearly between Business teams, Technical teams, and Dealers (role is a mix of IT, business, and customer facing)
  • Understanding of Parts management. Includes parts inventory, sales, and stocking policy experience (automotive preferred)

title: Engineering Support Specialist
description:
Job Description:

  • The Senior Energy Specialist will assist manufacturing facilities in developing and implementing projects to optimize energy used by buildings, processes, machines, and equipment to minimize energy loss and reduce energy waste during production and non- production periods.
  • The position will develop energy efficiency and conservation initiatives and monitor energy compliance.
  • Will also assist the manufacturing engineering organization in developing energy efficient standards, initiatives, and specifications, so that new facilities, processes, machines, and equipment will use less energy than those they replace.
  • This position will help support the 2030 carbon emissions reduction goal in supporting manufacturing plants and development of carbon neutrality roadmaps.
Responsibilities:
  • Assist the manufacturing engineering and global SPW Energy Domain organization to develop and deploy energy efficiency standards, initiatives, and specifications
  • Manage routine energy reports and regular monitoring of energy consumption and non-production curtailment results
  • Analyze plant energy KPI progress and communicate this information to plant, regional and global leadership
  • Support the implementation and maintenance of the plant's energy management system to meet ISO 50001 and SPW Energy Domain requirements.
  • Provide energy training and conduct annual documentation reviews (e.g., energy reviews, SEU matrix, training matrix)
  • Conduct regular energy treasure hunts/energy workshops/energy business club meetings and follow up to ensure implementation and advise plant leadership of findings
  • Assist plants with developing and updating energy action plans
  • Lead the development of energy best practice projects to improve key performance metrics
  • Support the global energy organization in the review and analysis of energy best practices and innovation-based projects
  • Support new equipment programs at the concept stage to ensure that energy design specifications and standards are included
  • Assist plants with participation in energy programs (e.g., rebates, demand response, strategic energy management)
  • Assist plants with energy benchmarking exercises (e.g., plant level, regional, global).
Requirements:
  • Minimum of five years of relevant energy experience in manufacturing and utilities such as compressed air systems, chillers, air handling units, and processes such as paint spray booths, paint ovens, parts washers, coolant pumping systems, etc.
  • Certified Energy Manager (CEM) professional certification
  • Competency in performing engineering analysis and calculations for all systems and processes that utilize electricity and natural gas.
  • A basic understanding of the utility and incentive process to help plants with collecting incentives and rebates for energy efficiency projects and initiatives
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Strong leadership, analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Proficient use of Microsoft Office suite and/or other software.
Preferred Qualifications:
  • At least 8 years of energy management
  • Additional energy related professional certifications (e.g., Engineer in Training (EIT), Professional Engineer (PE), Certified Energy Auditor (CEA), Certified Measurements and Verification Professions (CMVP))
Education:
  • Bachelor's Degree in Engineering

  • Ability to balance work effectively on multiple issues
  • Action a disciplined test plan and verification process to ensure quality calibrations are released.
  • Must have strong knowledge of the Powertrain system.
  • Knowledge of control system development tools such as Matlab Simulink and GT Power
  • Experience in Powertrain Control solutions development (powertrain control algorithms, On-board Diagnostics/OBD, embedded software)

  • Proven experience in Central Office, MSO, or Data Center installation.

  • Familiarity with Telcordia GR-1275 and AT&T TP-76300 / TP-76400.
  • Excellent organizational and time management skills.
  • Familiarity with multiple vendor platforms (Adtran, Cisco, Ciena, Infinera, etc.).

The Professional Division of Spherion Mid-Ohio is partnered with an established and mission-driven non-profit healthcare organization in Richland County seeking a Chief Financial Officer (CFO). This is a hybrid position with a salary range of $125K – $186K, based on skill set and experience. Come join their leadership team!

This is a direct hire opportunity — never go through a temp-to-hire process. If selected, day ONE you are this company's employee!

Are you a Controller, Director of Finance, or CPA ready to take the next step into an executive leadership role? A respected, mission-driven nonprofit healthcare organization in Richland County is seeking a Chief Financial Officer (CFO) to join its collaborative and forward-thinking leadership team.

As part of a forward-thinking and collaborative leadership team, you'll guide financial strategy, compliance, and operations in support of high-quality community care. Your insight and leadership will be recognized, valued, and make a lasting impact — starting day one.

Responsibilities:
Financial Strategy and Planning
• Develop and execute financial strategies aligned with the organization's mission and goals
• Lead the annual budget and long-term financial planning process
• Provide financial analysis to support strategic decision-making
Financial Management
• Oversee financial operations, including accounting, budgeting, billing, and revenue cycle management
• Monitor performance against budget and forecast; implement corrective actions as needed
• Ensure timely, accurate financial reporting to internal stakeholders and regulatory agencies
Compliance and Risk Management
• Ensure compliance with financial regulations, including HRSA guidelines
• Maintain internal controls to safeguard assets and mitigate financial risk
• Coordinate audits and reviews by external agencies
Grants Management
• Manage grant finances, including budget development, compliance, and reporting
• Collaborate with program managers to ensure effective and compliant use of grant funds
Leadership and Team Development
• Lead the finance team with a focus on accountability, transparency, and growth
• Mentor staff and support professional development and succession planning
• Oversee hiring, engagement, and career development in compliance with employment laws and EEOC standards
Collaborative Relationships
• Partner with executive leadership and department heads to meet organizational objectives
• Build strong relationships with funders, banks, and vendors
• Model positive leadership and uphold organizational values across the team

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities:
  • Expertise in health care financing, billing (CPT, HCPCS, ICD-10), and compliance (HIPAA, Medicare, Medicaid).
  • Proficient in financial planning, budgeting, reporting, and grant management (HRSA).
  • Strong understanding of GAAP, accounting software, and overseeing AP, AR, and general ledger functions.
  • Ability to manage internal controls, address compliance issues, and collaborate with auditors.
  • Leadership skills for motivating teams, presenting financial data, and strategic problem-solving.
  • Strong analytical, decision-making, and collaboration skills to address financial challenges.
  • Commitment to ethics, confidentiality, and continuous professional development.
Requirements:
  • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or related field (MBA or CPA preferred).
  • Minimum of 5 years of progressive financial leadership experience, preferably in a healthcare or nonprofit setting.
  • Strong understanding of financial management, healthcare financing, and regulatory requirements (especially HRSA).
  • Proven track record in financial strategy, budgeting, forecasting, grant management, and audit coordination.
  • Exceptional leadership, analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.
  • Proficiency with accounting software (experience in healthcare settings preferred).

description:
Job Title : Sr Integration Engineer with Intelligent Automation experience
(Hybrid)
Location:, Seattle (Preferred)/ San Francisco
Job Type: Contract (3+ months/possible extensions)

PR: $89/hr on W2

Job Summary
We are seeking an expert-level Senior Integration Developer to design, build, and govern mission-critical enterprise automation and integration solutions using Workato or Boomi. This role
demands deep technical proficiency across the entire Workato/Boomi platform, encompassing core iPaaS capabilities, advanced API management, and the latest Generative AI/Agentic
Orchestration features. The successful candidate will drive digital transformation, establish platform governance, and mentor junior developers.

Key Responsibilities
1. Solution Architecture & Development: Lead the end-to-end design, implementation, and deployment of complex, multi-step Recipes and Process Automation workflows, ensuring
optimal performance and scalability.
2. AI & Agentic Strategy: Develop, deploy, and manage autonomous AI Agents (Genies) using Agent Studio, ensuring they leverage internal context and execute secure actions
across connected enterprise applications.
3. API & Data Management: Design and govern secure, scalable API endpoints using the API Platform and implement robust Data Orchestration pipelines for bulk ETL/ELT and
data synchronization.
4. Hybrid Connectivity: Manage and troubleshoot connectivity to on-premise systems using the On-Premise Agent (OPA), databases, and private networks.
5. Governance & Operations: Implement enterprise-grade Security & Administration, including RBAC, SSO integration (Workato Identity), and lifecycle management (Smart
Versioning and deployment promotion).
6. Monitoring & Troubleshooting: Utilize Insights and job history to proactively monitor performance, diagnose complex job failures, and optimize recipes for cost and efficiency.
7.
UX Automation: Build employee-facing automation tools, including interactive Workbot (ChatOps) workflows and no-code Workflow Apps/AgentX Apps.
8. Technical Leadership: Create and maintain high-quality Technical Documentation, enforce best practices, and leverage the Community Library and AI Copilots to
accelerate development.
9. Business Application integrations : Integrate various business applications, including CRM, HR, Finance, LMS, Legal, Budget & Forecast and business communication and
collaboration platforms using Boomi.
10. Database : Develop and optimize SQL & PL SQL queries for database interactions.
11. Production Support : Provide production support for integration solutions, ensuring high availability and performance.
12. Human in loop : Building modern, interactive, and visually rich user interfaces for Slack apps, slash commands & slack API
13. Communication Protocols : Develop integration with all Communication Protocols (SFTP, REST & SOAP APIs, application specific connectors)
14. Financial integrations : At least 4+ years of experience in Financial integrations like AP, AR invoice, GL Accounting/Journals and Bank/treasury integration.
15. Payroll integration : At least 4+ years of experience in Payroll integrations
16. Legal integrations :At least 2+ years of experience in Payroll integration
17. Supply chain integration : At least 4+ years of experience in SCM integration.
18. Java/Groovy/Java script/Python : At least 4+ years experience in writing custom
scripting using any of the Java/Groovy/Java/Python script programming languages.
19. Git/GitHub Experience : Collaborate on code development and version control using
Git and GitHub. Manage repositories, branches, and pull requests to ensure a smooth and efficient development workflow

Required Qualifications and Experience
The ideal candidate must possess a minimum of 5 years of dedicated experience with the Workato platform and demonstrate mastery in the following domains:

Core Integration and Platform Expertise
  • Platform Mastery (5+ Years): Minimum 5 years of overall experience covering recipe design, job execution, governance, and platform administration. Expert in Core
  • Integration & Process Automation, including nested logic, advanced data transformation (Ruby/Python), and reusable callable functions.
  • Data Synchronization (4+ Years): Experience in large-scale Data Synchronization and ETL/ELT workflows, including bulk/batch actions and effective data management using

Data Tables and FileStorage.
  • API Management (4+ Years): Proven experience with the API Gateway, including deploying secure API endpoints, implementing API proxies, rate limiting, and handling
OAuth/JWT authentication.
  • Developer Tools (3+ Years): Experience extending the platform by building Custom Connectors using the Connector SDK and/or automating platform tasks via the
Developer API.
  • Event-Driven Architectures (3+ Years): Experience configuring event triggers/publishers for message queues and brokers (e.g., Kafka, Amazon SQS).
  • User Experience Automation (2+ Years): Experience building user-facing Workflow & AgentX Apps that incorporate human-in-the-loop steps.
  • Boomi Integration Experience: at least 3+ years of hands-on experience with Boomi integration.

Generative AI and Agentic Orchestration
Autonomous AI Agents (1+ Year): Practical experience designing and deploying autonomous AI Agents (Genies) in Agent Studio for complex, multi-system orchestration based on natural language intent.
AI Governance (1+ Year): Experience implementing enterprise governance, including RBAC and audit trails, for all actions performed by AI Agents.
Intelligent Document Processing (1+ Year): Experience implementing IDP workflows for
data extraction and classification from unstructured content.

Preferred Skills
Cloud Architecture: Familiarity with major cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) and their integration services.
● DevOps Practices: Experience implementing CI/CD pipelines for Workato recipes and managing deployment through version control (Git).
● Programming Languages: Strong command of at least one scripting language (Python, Ruby, or JavaScript) for custom connector logic and advanced recipe steps.
● Security Certifications: Knowledge of enterprise security standards and regulatory compliance (e.g., HIPAA, GDPR, SOC 2).
● Workato Certifications: Certified Workato Automation Pro III or equivalent experience.
● Industry Experience: Direct experience implementing Accelerators in a specific domain (e.g., Finance, HR, Sales Operations).

Work Environment:
● This position may require occasional on-call support for production issues, with assistance sometimes needed outside of regular work hours.
● The role may involve working with cross-functional teams and stakeholders.

description:

As the Agency continues to see increased growth of Enterprise Applications such as with the Electronic-Health-Records (EHR) initiative, the Agency's Office of Information Technology (Client) is upgrading the Agency's base network and wireless infrastructure to allow critical systems t o better leverage network resources, data, assets, infrastructure, and systems. Consistent with the best security practices, DPH has upgraded the Agency's enterprise wireless networking system with focus on integration into an existing Identity -Based Networking Services (IBNS) solution.

Responsibilities include statewide travel to agency facilities to assist with network equipment upgrades, facility relocations, issue resolution, and the installation and configuration of enterprise wireless access points.

The applicants selected will work under the general guidance of the Network Operations team but will also be required to work closely with other teams and Agency staff at all levels. Selected candidates will follow the Agency's Change Management process, and track and document the work and other tasks regularly communicating status updates to management and project manager.

The network administrators will work with Network, Security, and other IT professional groups and non-IT staff to assist with problem resolution, mitigation of issues, and to provide technical solutions. The network administrators will ensure assignments are completed accurately and on-time, and regularly provide: progress, tasks, and deliverables status updates to the assigned manager.

  • Support wireless and network connectivity on Windows-based systems

title: Engineer - Switchgear
description:
About the Role

We’re seeking an Electrical Engineer with a passion for power systems and hands-on switchgear technology to join our training and product support team. In this role, you’ll combine your technical expertise with strong communication skills to help build, deliver, and enhance training programs for Gas Insulated Switchgear (GIS) and related high-voltage equipment.

This is an excellent opportunity for an engineer from the utility, transmission/distribution, or OEM world who wants to grow into a subject matter expert and mentor others on next-generation gas-insulated equipment.

What You’ll Do

  • Support the design, development, and delivery of training programs for gas-insulated (SF₆) switchgear systems.

  • Learn and become the subject matter expert on the design, operation, startup, and maintenance of gas-insulated switchgear products.

  • Collaborate with engineers, technicians, and operations teams to ensure training reflects real-world field applications and safety standards.

  • Assist with technical troubleshooting and help implement corrective actions to continuously improve equipment performance and training content.

  • Stay current on industry standards, innovations, and best practices in switchgear and power distribution.

  • Provide additional support for related topics such as LOTO, vacuum/air switchgear, and breaker systems as training programs expand.

Who You Are

  • Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering or a related technical discipline.

  • 3+ years of experience in the power industry — utilities, transmission & distribution, or electrical equipment manufacturing preferred.

  • Working knowledge of electrical distribution systems, switchgear, or substation equipment.

  • Strong analytical, communication, and problem-solving skills.

  • Comfortable presenting technical material to both engineers and field technicians.

  • Proficient with engineering and presentation tools (e.g., CAD, PowerPoint, Excel, or similar).

  • Team-oriented, adaptable, and eager to learn new technologies.

Preferred Experience

  • Familiarity with Gas-Insulated (SF₆) or Air-Insulated Switchgear.

  • Exposure to GCB, vacuum breaker, or protection & control systems.

  • Experience with project execution, commissioning, or maintenance in a power systems environment.

  • Understanding of electrical safety practices and industry standards (IEEE, IEC, NETA, NFPA, OSHA).

  • Prior experience developing or delivering technical training is a plus (not required).

Why This Role

  • Unique opportunity to grow into a Subject Matter Expert (SME) for advanced switchgear systems.

  • Work alongside senior engineers and learn the latest GIS and high-voltage technologies.

  • Make a tangible impact by helping to train the next generation of power engineers and technicians.

  • Competitive compensation, professional growth opportunities, and exposure to cutting-edge electrical systems.

We are seeking a highly experienced Solder Assembler to join our precision electronics manufacturing team. The successful candidate will be an expert in both surface‐mount technology (SMT) and through‐hole soldering, with a proven track record of removing, repairing, and replacing a wide variety of components—including bottom‐terminated parts such as QFNs, BGAs, and LGAs. Conduct precise reflow, pre‐heat, and cooling cycles to meet component‐specific thermal profiles.
Operate and maintain X‐ray inspection equipment to evaluate solder joints on hidden pads and verify rework quality.
Interpret engineering drawings, work orders, and Bill of Materials (BOM) to ensure correct component placement and orientation.
Perform in‐process quality checks (visual, AOI, X‐ray) and document results per quality system requirements.
Troubleshoot solder‐related defects (e.g., tombstoning, voids, solder bridges) and implement corrective actions.
Maintain ESD‐controlled environments; follow all safety and compliance procedures.
Contribute to continuous‐improvement initiatives, suggesting tooling upgrades or process optimizations.
Familiarity with IPC (***) soldering standards, ISO‐9001, and AS9100 (defense/aerospace) quality systems.

title: Engineer Technical Lead - PT
description:
Engineer Technical Lead
Public Trust
DOJ Preferred 
Target Start: 12/1/25

Client is looking for a Engineer Technical Lead to support a large U.S. Department of Justice (DOJ) program.  The Antitrust Division of the U.S. Department of Justice (DOJ) is responsible for enforcing federal antitrust laws and promoting fair competition in the marketplace.  The Engineer Technical Lead will support and manage Microsoft Endpoint Configuration Manager (MECM) and AdminStudio to optimize endpoint management processes. In this role, you will lead technical efforts related to the deployment, configuration, and maintenance of enterprise-level systems. You will also be responsible for developing scripts to automate processes and improve efficiency. This role combines hands-on technical work with leadership in guiding and mentoring a team, ensuring the smooth execution of endpoint management tasks and services. This work is located onsite in the DC area.
 
Key Responsibilities:
  • Lead the administration and support of Microsoft Endpoint Configuration Manager (MECM), managing software deployments, updates, patches, and configurations across the organization.
  • Develop and maintain MECM configurations and collections for efficient deployment of operating systems, applications, and patches.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve issues related to MECM clients, deployment failures, and other endpoint-related issues.
  • Monitor and maintain MECM infrastructure and ensure it meets organizational needs for scalability, security, and performance.
  • Lead the implementation and configuration of AdminStudio to support application packaging, deployment, and software virtualization.
  • Collaborate with application owners to create, test, and deploy application packages in AdminStudio.
  • Ensure compatibility of applications with endpoint systems and manage packaging processes to streamline deployment.
  • Develop, test, and maintain scripts (e.g., PowerShell, Batch, VBScript) to automate system management tasks such as software deployments, configuration changes, and system updates.
  • Use scripting to improve efficiency in managing endpoint devices, reduce manual intervention, and ensure consistency across deployments.
  • Work with other team members to identify areas where automation and scripting can improve workflow efficiency.
  • Work closely with security teams to ensure endpoints are compliant with security policies, patches, and software updates.
  • Support endpoint configuration for compliance monitoring and reporting.
  • Ensure all endpoints are adequately protected from vulnerabilities and potential threats.
  • Create and maintain documentation for MECM configurations, packaging processes, and automation scripts.
 
Qualifications:
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.
  • 3-5 years of experience in endpoint management, with at least 2 years of hands-on experience supporting Microsoft Endpoint Configuration Manager (MECM) and AdminStudio.
  • Proven experience developing and maintaining scripts for endpoint automation (e.g., PowerShell, Batch, VBScript).
  • Experience in application packaging and deployment using AdminStudio or similar tools.
  • Familiarity with Active Directory, Group Policy, and other endpoint management technologies.
  • Expertise in Microsoft Endpoint Configuration Manager (MECM) for software deployment, patch management, and operating system deployment.
  • Proficient in scripting languages such as PowerShell, Batch, or VBScript for task automation and configuration management.
  • Knowledge of AdminStudio for application packaging, deployment, and testing.
  • Experience with endpoint security management, including software patching and compliance reporting.
  • Familiarity with SQL queries for reporting and troubleshooting in MECM.
  • Knowledge of Windows Server and Windows OS configurations and management.
  • Strong troubleshooting skills for resolving deployment failures, configuration issues, and system performance problems.
  • Ability to think critically and identify solutions that improve processes and enhance operational efficiency.
  • Strong leadership and mentoring skills to guide junior engineers and cross-functional teams.
  • Excellent communication skills to collaborate with business stakeholders and technical teams.
 
Desirable Skills:
  • Certifications:
    • Microsoft Certified: Modern Desktop Administrator Associate or other Microsoft certifications related to endpoint management.
    • AdminStudio Certification or similar packaging tool certification.
    • ITIL Foundation or similar IT service management certifications.
  • Familiarity with Power BI or other reporting tools for generating endpoint management metrics and dashboards.
  • Experience with other endpoint management tools (e.g., SCCM, Intune, AirWatch).

title: Welder
description:
Job Summary
The Welder is responsible for performing precision welding and related operations on small aerospace components. This role involves operating semi-automated welding machines, conducting TIG and EB welding, and maintaining tooling and equipment to ensure high-quality production standards. The ideal candidate demonstrates strong technical skills, attention to detail, and a commitment to maintaining quality and safety standards in a regulated aerospace environment.

Job Responsibilities

  • Operate semi-automated welding machines for precision component manufacturing.

  • Perform TIG and EB welding operations on small aerospace parts.

  • Assemble, set up, and maintain tooling and fixtures.

  • Conduct leak testing operations and maintain accurate quality records.

  • Operate heat treat and furnace brazing equipment as required.

  • Perform spot welding, tinning, and drilling of housings.

  • Ensure all work meets quality, safety, and compliance standards, including ITAR requirements.

  • Maintain a clean and organized work area.

  • Perform additional duties as assigned to support production operations.

Job Requirements

  • High school diploma or equivalent required.

  • Minimum of 1 year of machinist and/or welding experience.

  • Ability to qualify to AWS D17.1 welding standards.

  • Must be able to lift up to 70 pounds.

  • Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without company sponsorship.

  • This position requires access to information or hardware subject to the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR); candidates must meet ITAR requirements as a U.S. person (U.S. Citizen, Permanent Resident, Political Asylee, or Refugee).

Education

  • High school diploma or GED required.

Work Experience

  • At least 1 year of relevant welding or machining experience, preferably in aerospace or precision manufacturing environments.

Additional Job Details

  • Position requires compliance with all applicable safety, quality, and ITAR regulations

title: Stockroom Clerk I
description:

The Stockroom Clerk I is responsible for performing a variety of material management and inventory control tasks to ensure the timely and accurate movement of materials throughout the facility.   • Unpack and inspect incoming materials, record shortages, and reject damaged items when necessary.

Job Requirements

  • Location: Camarillo, CA

title: Inspector
description:
Job Summary
The CCA Inspector is responsible for performing visual and dimensional inspections of circuit card assemblies (CCAs) to ensure compliance with manufacturing and industry standards, including IPC-A-610 and IPC-J-STD-001. This position requires precision, attention to detail, and the ability to identify defects in soldering and conformal coating applications. The CCA Inspector uses predetermined inspection methods, tools, and documentation to verify product quality and ensure conformance to specifications.

Job Responsibilities

  • Perform 100% visual inspection of circuit card assemblies in accordance with IPC-A-610 and IPC-J-STD-001 requirements.

  • Inspect solder joints, conformal coatings, and component placement using microscopes and magnification tools.

  • Utilize drawings, parts lists, and written inspection instructions to verify compliance with customer and industry specifications.

  • Use measuring devices such as dial indicators, preset micrometers, and scales to confirm dimensional accuracy.

  • Document inspection results accurately and maintain quality records in compliance with company procedures.

  • Identify and report nonconforming materials and workmanship issues.

  • Collaborate effectively with manufacturing and engineering teams to resolve quality issues.

  • Support continuous improvement by identifying opportunities to enhance inspection processes and product quality.

  • Maintain a clean, organized, and safe work environment.

  • Perform other related duties as assigned.

Job Requirements

  • High school diploma or equivalent required.

  • Minimum of 2 years of solder or visual inspection experience, or 2 years of manufacturing/soldering experience with electronic assemblies.

  • Minimum of 1 year of conformal coating inspection experience.

  • Strong understanding of IPC-A-610 and IPC-J-STD-001 standards.

  • Proficiency in reading and interpreting engineering drawings, diagrams, and reference documents.

  • Strong attention to detail with a commitment to quality and process accuracy.

  • Ability to work under a microscope for extended periods (up to 10 hours).

  • Ability to sit for long durations at a workstation.

  • Effective verbal and written communication skills; able to interface professionally with all levels of manufacturing personnel.

  • Proficient with personal computers and basic software applications.

  • Team-oriented with a collaborative and solutions-driven approach.

Education

  • High school diploma or equivalent required.

  • IPC-A-610 and/or J-STD-001 certification preferred.

Work Experience

  • At least 2 years of experience in soldering, assembly, or visual inspection of electronic assemblies required.

  • Prior experience in conformal coating inspection highly preferred.

Additional Job Details

  • Location: Oldsmar, FL

  • Schedule: 1st Shift, 5:00 a.m. – 3:30 p.m.

  • This position requires precision work under magnification and adherence to strict quality standards.

title: Panel Technician
description:
Job Summary
The Senior Panel Technician is responsible for fabricating, integrating, inspecting, and testing ground safety equipment assemblies, panels, and racks that support critical spaceflight systems. This role plays a key part in the integration of electronic and electromechanical systems for major aerospace programs. The Senior Panel Technician ensures that all assemblies meet stringent technical, quality, and safety standards, contributing directly to the success of advanced human spaceflight initiatives.

This is a contract-to-hire, 100% onsite position based initially in Western Florida, with potential transition to a space operations facility upon project completion. Local candidates only; per diem is not offered.

Job Responsibilities

  • Assemble, install, and integrate complex electronic, pneumatic, and electromechanical components for aerospace systems.

description:
Company Name: VARITE India Private Limited

About The Client:
Visionet is a premier digital technology solutions company built on the premise of disruptive innovation. For over 27 years, our innovation-centric and engineering-first approach has unlocked digital-driven success to over 350+ global enterprises across Client, Retail, Banking & Financial Services, Food & Beverage, Manufacturing & Distribution, and Life Sciences industries.
